person.bibl: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
person.note: This scholar's father (and therefore the grand-father of Periappā Kavi) was named Kṛṣṇa, and according to the prologue of the Śṛṅgāramañjarīśāhajīya, he was proficient in Vedānta: kṛtavedāntasiddhāntaḥ kṛṣṇo yasya pitāmahaḥ |
